title: 1.2 Measuring and Constructing Segments

icans: I can find the length of a segment on a number line or ruler.
I can tell whether two segments are congruent.
I can use the Segment Addition Postulate to find lengths.

vocab: a rule that is ___________ without proof
B is between A and C when A, B, and C are ____________ and B is on A̅C̅

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Ruler Postulate: the distance between two points on a number line is the _______________ of the difference of their coordinates: AB = |x₂ − x₁|.

blocks.stem: On a number line, A is at −3 and B is at 5. Find AB.

notes: Congruent segments: A̅B̅ ≅ C̅D̅ means the segments have the same _______________: AB = CD.
Segment Addition Postulate: if B is between A and C, then AB + _______________ = AC.

blocks.stem: B is between A and C. AB = 9 and BC = 13. Find AC.
M is between L and N. LM = 2x, MN = x + 7, and LN = 25. Find x, LM, and MN.
X is between W and Y. WX = 3x − 1, XY = 2x + 4, and WY = 28. Find x, WX, and XY.

tickets.stem: On a number line, P is at 2 and Q is at −9. Find PQ.
B is between A and C. AB = 7 and AC = 19. Find BC.
